title: Mark a claim verified only when the source supports it
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads a source document and claim, runs product step `judge` (fixture cassette offline; live System One when enabled) for: Mark a claim verified only when the source supports it. He verifies claim_verified / escalate from the typed support answer and confidence floor.
implementation: Product CLI verb `judge` (`JudgeVerb`): JudgeRequest over source+claim state via injected JudgeProvider. Code-owned claim_verified = selected==supported ∧ conf≥floor.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `matching_claim.yaml`: judge step + response.json cassette; hard expects on claim_verified / escalate. Live (`MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live` + `MECHA_JUDGE_*`): same scenario via `SystemOneJudgeProvider` (cassette-exact token softens; behavioral expects hard).
